# Offgrid Training

> A private, offline workout tracker for iOS.

Offgrid Training is a private, offline workout tracker built for training without compromises. Your training data stays on your device: no accounts, no cloud, no ads, and no analytics.

## Features

- Log sets, reps, weight, duration, distance, RPE, calories, pace, volume, and estimated 1RM
- Create custom exercise types for the way you train
- Define your own tracked values with numbers, time, text, units, progress direction, and formulas
- Build workouts with normal groups, planned exercise slots, and supersets
- Save reusable workout templates
- Track personal records and follow progress with charts
- Organize your exercise library with categories and variations
- Choose metric or imperial units
- Back up, restore, export, import, and transfer your data
- Use built-in types for strength, cardio, and flexibility, or create your own for mobility, conditioning, running drills, skill work, music practice, or anything else you want to measure

## Privacy

- 100% offline — no internet required
- No account required
- No cloud sync
- No ads or advertising SDKs
- No analytics or third-party tracking
- All workout data stored locally on device
